note: Hand-curated baseline snapshot for the site launch (issue #100). Unlike data/metrics.json, this is not refreshed by an automated pipeline — update it manually when a signal is re-measured, recording the new snapshot date.

signals.label: GitHub stars
signals.note: Repo-level engagement signal; cheapest to measure, easiest to game, tracked alongside the others rather than alone.

signals.label: GitHub watchers
signals.note: Proxy for people who want ongoing visibility into the project, not just a one-time star.

signals.label: GitHub forks
signals.note: Baseline of 1 is the maintainer's own working fork, not an external contributor.

signals.label: Good-first-issues claimed or closed by a non-maintainer
signals.note: Directly measures whether curated on-ramp issues (issue #98) convert visitors into contributors.

signals.label: Inbound links from cncf.io / contribute.cncf.io properties
signals.source: manual check via site search or referrer data once analytics exists
signals.note: At least one authoritative CNCF property should link to this site by the 90-day mark; there is no analytics pipeline yet to measure traffic directly, so this is checked manually until one is added.
